info.title: Pctl Manager
info.author: Taylor
info.description: Parental controls without the phone app
info.details:
Configure the Switch daily play-time limit offline — no phone app, no Nintendo account, no internet. Talks to the system `pctl` service directly so the limit lives on the console.

Features:
- Set one daily limit for all days, or per-day limits (Sun–Sat).
- Remove the play-time limit entirely.
- Set / change the parental-controls PIN (via the system passcode applet).
- Delete all parental controls — your recovery when the PIN has been forgotten.
- Unlink the Nintendo Switch Parental Controls companion phone app.
- View status: PIN length, restrictions on/off, play-timer state.

When the play timer is currently active, writes first turn parental controls off temporarily (it reads the PIN automatically — no need to remember it) so writing the new limit doesn't destabilise Atmosphère; the new limit takes effect once parental controls re-engage.

Horizon-style graphical UI built on borealis.

Requires CFW (Atmosphère recommended). Tested on fw 22.1.0 / Atmosphère 1.11.1; other versions unverified.

changelog:
v3.1.0
v3.1.0 — play-timer fixes, bedtime alarm, launch PIN check.

Fixes for every open issue, a bedtime alarm, and a PlayTimerSettings layout confirmed by reversing the fw 22.5.0 pctl sysmodule (see docs/pctl-reverse-engineering.md: https://github.com/tailiang2008/NX-Pctl-Manager/blob/v3.1.0/docs/pctl-reverse-engineering.md).

Many thanks to @puppywang: https://github.com/puppywang, who contributed the fixes and features in this release (8: https://github.com/tailiang2008/NX-Pctl-Manager/pull/8).

 Fixes

- The limit now applies right after writing it (3, 6, 7).- v3.0.0 unlocked parental controls temporarily (cmd 1201) and never re-locked them. Every write now ends with cmd 1007 RevertRestrictionTemporaryUnlocked. The "Turn off & write" prompt is gone.
- The timer counts down on offline consoles (2).- pctl only enables the timer when the NetworkSystemClock is valid, and a console that can't reach Nintendo never sets it. The app now detects this at launch and offers to set the network clock from the system clock. The main menu has the same option.
- Error 0x1088E when writing (5).- This is pctl's "no PIN registered" result. A PIN is now required before any play-timer write; without one, pctl silently discards the settings anyway.
- Removing the limit goes through the same guarded write. In v3.0.0, removing it while the "time's up" screen was up could crash Atmosphère.
- Per-day editor: a day can be set back to "no limit".
- Play-timer reads and writes are refused below fw 21.0.0, where the struct has a different size.
- Fixed a start-up crash on fw 22.x. borealis rejects the multiline Label attribute, and the uncaught exception left its task thread running after exit (2168-0001).

 New

- Bedtime alarm (4).- Set a start time and the next-morning end time, applied to every day. The app reads the values back through pctl's own getters to confirm the write.
- When time is up:- suspend the software (default) or notify only.
- Launch-time PIN check.- The tool can lift every restriction, so it now asks for the console's parental-control PIN first.
- Diagnostic report.- A read-only dump of firmware, clocks, the raw and decoded settings, and the bedtime getters is saved to sd:/switch/nx_pctl_dump.txt.
- Logs on the SD card.- Writes go to sd:/switch/nx_pctl_manager.log and borealis output to sd:/switch/nx_pctl_borealis.log.
- Simplified Chinese translation.
- The PROBE build option was removed. Its diagnostic dump is now always available.

Tested on fw 22.5.0 / Atmosphère 1.12.0 (emuMMC).

 Before you upgrade
- Firmware 21.0.0 or newer- is required for the play-timer features.
- A parental-control PIN is required- to write any play-time setting, and the app asks for it at launch. It can no longer be used to recover a forgotten PIN.
- Offline consoles:- accept the prompt to set the network clock, or the timer won't count down.

See CHANGELOG.md: https://github.com/tailiang2008/NX-Pctl-Manager/blob/v3.1.0/CHANGELOG.md for the full history.

 Install
Drop nx_pctl_manager.nro into /switch/ on the SD card and launch it from hbmenu. Or download nx_pctl_manager.zip and unzip it onto the SD card root (it places the .nro into /switch/ for you).

v3.0.0
UI rewrite onto borealis — Horizon-system-style graphical UI replaces the v2 text console. No functional changes — every action behaves the same.
